text: Remove says "Removed Ceramic mug" with an Undo button
trigger: remove the Ceramic mug from the cart
setup: the cart is the $50.00 seed cart (Canvas tote bag + Ceramic mug)
expected: The message "Removed Ceramic mug" appears with an "Undo" button
sourceQuote: "Remove" shows the message "Removed Ceramic mug" (with the item's name) and an "Undo" button.

text: Undo brings the item back with its quantity
trigger: set the mug's quantity to 2, remove it, then press "Undo"
setup: the cart is the $50.00 seed cart (Canvas tote bag + Ceramic mug)
expected: The Ceramic mug is back in the cart with quantity 2
sourceQuote: "Undo" puts the item back in the cart with the quantity it had.

trigger: set the mug's quantity to 2, remove it, then press "Undo"
setup: the cart is the $50.00 seed cart (Canvas tote bag + Ceramic mug)
expected: The subtotal and total are $70.00 again, as before the remove
sourceQuote: The subtotal and total go back to what they were before the remove.
